requirements.title: Zone::to_string returns unique human-readable name
requirements.text: rcp::to_string(Zone) shall return a unique, non-empty, human-readable string for each defined Zone constant. Two distinct Zone constants shall never return the same string.

requirements.title: Zone::Unknown has value 0
requirements.text: Zone::Unknown shall have the numeric value 0, making it the zero value of the Zone type and a safe default for uninitialized variables.

requirements.title: Zone::FrontLeft has value 1
requirements.text: Zone::FrontLeft shall have the numeric value 1.

requirements.title: Zone::FrontRight has value 2
requirements.text: Zone::FrontRight shall have the numeric value 2.

requirements.title: Zone::RearLeft has value 3
requirements.text: Zone::RearLeft shall have the numeric value 3.

requirements.title: Zone::RearRight has value 4
requirements.text: Zone::RearRight shall have the numeric value 4.

requirements.title: Zone::Central has value 5
requirements.text: Zone::Central shall have the numeric value 5.

requirements.title: All named Zone constants are distinct
requirements.text: Zone::FrontLeft, Zone::FrontRight, Zone::RearLeft, Zone::RearRight, and Zone::Central shall each have a different numeric value from every other named zone constant.

requirements.title: Priority::Normal has value 0
requirements.text: Priority::Normal shall have the numeric value 0, making it the zero value of Priority and the safe default for Command fields left unset.

requirements.title: Priority::High is greater than Priority::Normal
requirements.text: The numeric value of Priority::High shall be strictly greater than Priority::Normal.

requirements.title: Priority::Critical is greater than Priority::High
requirements.text: The numeric value of Priority::Critical shall be strictly greater than Priority::High.

requirements.title: CommandType::Noop has value 0
requirements.text: CommandType::Noop shall have the numeric value 0. An uninitialized Command.type shall be interpreted as a safe no-op.

requirements.title: CommandType::Set has value 1
requirements.text: CommandType::Set shall have the numeric value 1.

requirements.title: CommandType::Get has value 2
requirements.text: CommandType::Get shall have the numeric value 2.

requirements.title: CommandType::Reset has value 3
requirements.text: CommandType::Reset shall have the numeric value 3.

requirements.title: CommandType::Watchdog has value 4
requirements.text: CommandType::Watchdog shall have the numeric value 4. The watchdog kick command shall be a stable, named constant.

requirements.title: All CommandType constants are distinct
requirements.text: CommandType::Noop, Set, Get, Reset, and Watchdog shall each have a different numeric value.

requirements.title: ResponseStatus::to_string returns unique human-readable name
requirements.text: rcp::to_string(ResponseStatus) shall return a unique, non-empty, human-readable string for each defined ResponseStatus constant.

requirements.title: ResponseStatus::OK has value 0
requirements.text: ResponseStatus::OK shall have the numeric value 0. An uninitialized Response.status shall be interpreted as success.

requirements.title: ResponseStatus::Error has value 1
requirements.text: ResponseStatus::Error shall have the numeric value 1.

requirements.title: ResponseStatus::Timeout has value 2
requirements.text: ResponseStatus::Timeout shall have the numeric value 2.

requirements.title: ResponseStatus::Busy has value 3
requirements.text: ResponseStatus::Busy shall have the numeric value 3.

requirements.title: All ResponseStatus constants are distinct
requirements.text: ResponseStatus::OK, Error, Timeout, Busy, and Unknown shall each have a different numeric value.

requirements.title: ErrClosed is truthy
requirements.text: The sentinel error ErrClosed shall evaluate to true in a boolean context so callers can distinguish it from a default (zero) error_code.

requirements.title: ErrNotFound is truthy
requirements.text: The sentinel error ErrNotFound shall be truthy.

requirements.title: ErrAlreadyExists is truthy
requirements.text: The sentinel error ErrAlreadyExists shall be truthy.

requirements.title: ErrTimeout is truthy
requirements.text: The sentinel error ErrTimeout shall be truthy.

requirements.title: ErrBusy is truthy
requirements.text: The sentinel error ErrBusy shall be truthy.

requirements.title: All sentinel errors are mutually distinct
requirements.text: ErrClosed, ErrNotFound, ErrAlreadyExists, ErrTimeout, ErrBusy, and ErrZoneMismatch shall all be distinct std::error_code values (different value or category).

requirements.title: ErrClosed detectable by value comparison
requirements.text: Any error_code returned by a closed Controller or Registry shall compare equal to ErrClosed. Callers must be able to detect closed-entity conditions without parsing error strings.

requirements.title: ErrNotFound detectable by value comparison
requirements.text: Any error_code returned for a missing zone lookup shall compare equal to ErrNotFound.

requirements.title: ErrAlreadyExists detectable by value comparison
requirements.text: Any error_code returned for a duplicate zone registration shall compare equal to ErrAlreadyExists.

requirements.title: ErrTimeout detectable by value comparison
requirements.text: Any error_code returned due to a context deadline expiry shall compare equal to ErrTimeout.

requirements.title: ErrZoneMismatch is a distinct truthy sentinel error
requirements.text: ErrZoneMismatch shall be truthy and distinct from all other sentinel errors so callers can detect zone-misrouting without parsing error strings.

requirements.title: Zero-value Command is a safe no-op
requirements.text: A zero-initialised Command shall have zone=Zone::Unknown, type=CommandType::Noop, and priority=Priority::Normal.

requirements.title: Command.payload may be empty
requirements.text: Command.payload shall be optional; an empty payload shall be accepted by any Controller::send implementation without error or crash.

requirements.title: Response.command_id echoes the originating Command.id
requirements.text: Controller::send shall return a Response whose command_id field equals the id field of the submitted Command.

requirements.title: Response.zone identifies the zone that processed the command
requirements.text: Controller::send shall return a Response whose zone field equals the Zone of the Controller that processed the command.

requirements.title: Zero-value Response has ResponseStatus::OK
requirements.text: A zero-initialised Response shall have status=ResponseStatus::OK (value 0).

requirements.title: Status.zone identifies the publishing controller
requirements.text: Every Status published by a Controller shall carry a zone field equal to the Controller's declared zone.

requirements.title: Status.seq is monotonically increasing
requirements.text: Each successive Status published by a given Controller instance shall have a seq value strictly greater than the previous one.

requirements.title: Status.healthy is true while the controller is open
requirements.text: A Status published by a Controller that has not yet been closed shall carry healthy=true.

requirements.title: Status.payload carries the bytes passed to publish
requirements.text: Status.payload in every delivered Status update shall be byte-for-byte identical to the payload argument supplied to the publish call that produced it.

requirements.title: Status.payload may be empty
requirements.text: publish shall accept an empty payload without error or crash. The resulting Status.payload shall be empty.

requirements.title: Server starts HW_UNCONFIGURED with a representative two-endpoint register map
requirements.text: rcp::mock::Server shall construct with rcp::lifecycle::ServerLifecycle in state HwUnconfigured and an rcp::regmap::RegisterMap whose endpoint_count, generic_configs, functional_configs, and ep_id_mapping describe exactly two endpoints: GPIO at endpoint id/byte_bus_id 1 and SPI at endpoint id/byte_bus_id 2.

requirements.title: advance_to_rcp_configured drives the lifecycle straight to RCP_CONFIGURED
requirements.text: rcp::mock::Server::advance_to_rcp_configured shall advance the server's ServerLifecycle from HwUnconfigured through HwConfigured to RcpConfigured and return a falsy std::error_code, since Server supplies no PlausibilityCheck of its own.

requirements.title: EP0 read answers the register map's magic number for any client
requirements.text: rcp::mock::Server::dispatch, for a read request addressed to regmap::kEp0, shall return a ReadResponse whose payload is the RegisterMap::magic field encoded big-endian, for any client identity, per Ep0::check_read_access's unrestricted-read rule.

requirements.title: EP0 write via dispatch is always rejected
requirements.text: rcp::mock::Server::dispatch, for a write request addressed to regmap::kEp0, shall return regmap::RegMapErrc::request_rejected and an ErrorResponse, since whole-map writes are only reachable through Ep0::write_whole_map directly, not through dispatch.

requirements.title: write_whole_map requires the root client
requirements.text: rcp::mock::Server::ep0()'s write_whole_map shall return regmap::RegMapErrc::unauthorized_access for any client that is not the current root client, and shall apply the replacement RegisterMap when called by the root client.

requirements.title: Operational GPIO/SPI requests are rejected before RCP_CONFIGURED
requirements.text: rcp::mock::Server::dispatch, for a request addressed to the GPIO or SPI endpoint while the server's lifecycle state is not RcpConfigured, shall return regmap::RegMapErrc::request_rejected and an ErrorResponse without touching either endpoint's live state.

requirements.title: GPIO write applies evt[2:0] semantics and read reflects the new state
requirements.text: rcp::mock::Server::dispatch, for a write request addressed to the GPIO endpoint while RcpConfigured, shall decode the request's evt[2:0] field as an endpoint::WriteSemantics, apply it to the endpoint's live pin-value bitmask via gpio::GpioEndpoint::handle_write, and a subsequent read request shall observe the resulting value.

requirements.title: GPIO write with evt_ack set produces an Acknowledge response
requirements.text: rcp::mock::Server::dispatch, for a GPIO write request with AcfMessageInfo::evt_ack set, shall build its response via acf::ResponseKind::Acknowledge instead of WriteResponse.

requirements.title: SPI transfer answers with the scripted POCI-in bytes for the addressed channel
requirements.text: rcp::mock::Server::dispatch, for a request addressed to the SPI endpoint while RcpConfigured, shall decode the request's evt[2:0] field as a channel selector, drive spi::SpiEndpoint::transfer with the request payload as PICO-out data and whatever bytes set_spi_poci last scripted for that channel as POCI-in data, and answer with those POCI-in bytes as a ReadResponse.

requirements.title: dispatch to an unmapped byte_bus_id reports invalid_parameter
requirements.text: rcp::mock::Server::dispatch, for a request whose byte_bus_id addresses neither EP0, GPIO, nor SPI, shall return regmap::RegMapErrc::invalid_parameter and an ErrorResponse.

requirements.title: Controller::send returns StatusOK with no handler
requirements.text: When no Handler is configured, Controller::send shall return a Response with status=ResponseStatus::OK.

requirements.title: Controller::send dispatches to the configured handler
requirements.text: When a Handler is configured, Controller::send shall invoke the handler exactly once per send call and return the handler's Response.

requirements.title: Controller::send rejected after close
requirements.text: Controller::send called after Controller::close shall return ErrClosed.

requirements.title: Controller::send respects an already-done context
requirements.text: If the Context passed to Controller::send is already done at call time, send shall return ErrTimeout without invoking the handler.

requirements.title: Controller::close is idempotent
requirements.text: Controller::close shall be safe to call multiple times. Every call after the first shall return a success error_code without side effects.

requirements.title: Published Status is delivered to all active subscribers
requirements.text: A Status produced by publish shall be received by every channel returned by an active subscribe call on the same controller.

requirements.title: Subscribe channels are closed when the controller closes
requirements.text: When Controller::close is called, all channels previously returned by subscribe shall be closed.

requirements.title: Subscribe rejected after close
requirements.text: Controller::subscribe called after Controller::close shall return ErrClosed. No channel shall be returned.

requirements.title: Controller::zone returns the declared zone
requirements.text: Controller::zone shall return the Zone value provided at construction time for the lifetime of the controller.

requirements.title: Subscribe seq values are strictly increasing
requirements.text: Successive Status updates received on a subscribe channel shall carry strictly increasing seq values.

requirements.title: Subscribe channel is closed when its context is done
requirements.text: When the Context passed to subscribe becomes done, the channel returned by that subscribe call shall be closed.

requirements.title: Multiple concurrent subscribers each receive published Status
requirements.text: When multiple subscribe calls are active on the same controller, each returned channel shall independently receive every Status published via publish.

requirements.title: CommandType::Noop is accepted without error
requirements.text: Controller::send with Command.type=CommandType::Noop shall return ResponseStatus::OK and shall not return an error.

requirements.title: CommandType::Watchdog is accepted without error
requirements.text: Controller::send with Command.type=CommandType::Watchdog shall return ResponseStatus::OK and shall not return an error.

requirements.title: CommandType::Reset is accepted without error
requirements.text: Controller::send with Command.type=CommandType::Reset shall return ResponseStatus::OK and shall not return an error.

requirements.title: Handler Response is returned verbatim
requirements.text: When a Handler is configured, the Response returned by the handler shall be returned directly by Controller::send without modification.

requirements.title: Publish on a closed controller does not crash
requirements.text: Calling publish on a controller after Controller::close shall not throw or crash.

requirements.title: Concurrent send calls are data-race free
requirements.text: Multiple concurrent calls to Controller::send on the same controller shall be free of data races.

requirements.title: Concurrent publish and subscribe are data-race free
requirements.text: Concurrent calls to publish and subscribe on the same controller shall be free of data races.

requirements.title: Subscribe channel carries the correct Zone
requirements.text: Every Status received on a subscribe channel shall carry a zone field equal to the subscribing Controller's zone.

requirements.title: Subscribe channel carries correct Payload
requirements.text: Status.payload on each received update shall be byte-for-byte identical to the payload argument of the publish call that produced it.

requirements.title: Subscribe channel carries healthy=true for open controller
requirements.text: Status.healthy shall be true on every update published while the controller is open.

requirements.title: Done context does not invoke handler
requirements.text: If the Context passed to send is already done, the Handler shall not be invoked.

requirements.title: Send with empty payload does not crash
requirements.text: Controller::send with an empty Command.payload shall not throw or crash.

requirements.title: Controller::send rejects commands whose zone does not match the controller zone
requirements.text: Controller::send shall return ErrZoneMismatch when cmd.zone does not equal the zone declared by the controller.

requirements.title: Controller::send copies Command.payload before passing to the handler
requirements.text: Controller::send shall copy Command.payload before invoking the handler. Subsequent modification of the original payload by the caller shall not affect the bytes seen by the handler.

requirements.title: Controller::publish copies the payload before embedding in Status
requirements.text: Controller::publish shall copy the payload argument before embedding it in the Status value delivered to subscribers.

requirements.title: new_registry pre-populates all five standard zones
requirements.text: A Registry returned by mock::new_registry shall contain controllers for Zone::FrontLeft, FrontRight, RearLeft, RearRight, and Central.

requirements.title: Duplicate zone registration returns ErrAlreadyExists
requirements.text: Registry::register_ctrl for a zone that already has a registered controller shall return ErrAlreadyExists.

requirements.title: Deregister removes the zone and closes its controller
requirements.text: Registry::deregister shall remove the controller for the given zone and call close on it. After deregistration, lookup for the same zone shall return ErrNotFound.

requirements.title: Lookup returns ErrNotFound for an absent zone
requirements.text: Registry::lookup for a zone with no registered controller shall return ErrNotFound.

requirements.title: Registry::close is idempotent
requirements.text: Registry::close shall be safe to call multiple times. Every call after the first shall succeed without side effects.

requirements.title: Controllers returns all currently registered controllers
requirements.text: Registry::controllers shall return exactly the set of controllers currently registered, with no duplicates and no omissions.

requirements.title: Register rejected after Registry::close
requirements.text: Registry::register_ctrl called after Registry::close shall return ErrClosed.

requirements.title: Deregister returns ErrNotFound for a zone that was never registered
requirements.text: Registry::deregister for a zone with no registered controller shall return ErrNotFound.

requirements.title: Registered controller is immediately retrievable via lookup
requirements.text: After a successful Registry::register_ctrl call, Registry::lookup for the same zone shall return the registered controller without error.

requirements.title: Registry::close calls close on all registered controllers
requirements.text: Registry::close shall call close on every controller currently registered before returning.

requirements.title: Lookup on a closed Registry returns an error
requirements.text: Registry::lookup called after Registry::close shall return a non-success error_code.

requirements.title: Deregister for an already-deregistered zone returns ErrNotFound
requirements.text: A second call to Registry::deregister for a zone that was already deregistered shall return ErrNotFound.

requirements.title: Registry::lookup returns ErrClosed when called on a closed registry
requirements.text: Registry::lookup called after Registry::close shall return ErrClosed specifically, not ErrNotFound.

requirements.title: Frame round-trips an NTSCF-framed ACF_ABB request
requirements.text: rcp::udp::encode_frame/decode_frame shall round-trip a Frame carrying an NTSCF header (rcp::avtp::NtscfHeader) wrapping an ACF_ABB message (rcp::acf::AcfMessageInfo) unchanged: stream_id, sequence_num, the request's byte_bus_id/transaction_num/op, and its payload shall all be recoverable from the encoded bytes.

requirements.title: Frame round-trips a TSCF-framed request with avtp_timestamp
requirements.text: rcp::udp::encode_frame/decode_frame shall round-trip a Frame carrying a TSCF header (rcp::avtp::TscfHeader), including its timestamp_valid flag and 32-bit avtp_timestamp, unchanged.

requirements.title: Frame round-trips an ACF_GBB message_timestamp
requirements.text: rcp::udp::encode_frame/decode_frame shall round-trip a Frame whose AcfMessageInfo::acf_msg_type is kAcfMsgTypeGbb, including its mtv flag, 64-bit message_timestamp, and payload, unchanged.

requirements.title: decode_frame rejects a buffer shorter than the AVTPDU header
requirements.text: rcp::udp::decode_frame shall return a non-zero std::error_code when given fewer bytes than the AVTPDU header (NTSCF or TSCF, selected by the subtype byte) requires.

requirements.title: decode_frame rejects a buffer shorter than the ACF common header
requirements.text: rcp::udp::decode_frame shall return a non-zero std::error_code when the AVTPDU header decodes successfully but fewer bytes than the 10-byte ACF common header (rcp::acf::kAcfCommonHeaderLen) remain.

requirements.title: decode_frame rejects an unrecognized ACF message type
requirements.text: rcp::udp::decode_frame shall return a non-zero std::error_code when the byte immediately following a valid AVTPDU header is neither rcp::acf::kAcfMsgTypeAbb nor rcp::acf::kAcfMsgTypeGbb.

requirements.title: Server dispatches a decoded request through its handler and answers the sender
requirements.text: rcp::udp::Server shall decode each inbound UDP datagram as a Frame, invoke its registered Handler with the decoded AcfMessageInfo and payload, and send the handler's response back to the originating sender address, framed under the same NTSCF/TSCF header kind the request arrived under.

requirements.title: Server answers Acknowledge by default when no handler is registered
requirements.text: rcp::udp::Server shall respond to a decoded request with rcp::acf::ResponseKind::Acknowledge when no Handler has been set via set_handler.

requirements.title: Server assigns stable per-sender client ids
requirements.text: rcp::udp::Server shall pass the same opaque client id to its Handler for every request originating from the same sender address, and a distinct id for a request from a different sender address.

requirements.title: Client::request returns ErrTimeout when no response arrives
requirements.text: rcp::udp::Client::request shall return rcp::ErrTimeout when the supplied rcp::Context's deadline elapses before a matching response frame is received.

requirements.title: Client::request correlates concurrent requests by byte_bus_id/transaction_num
requirements.text: rcp::udp::Client::request shall match each inbound response frame to the pending request whose AcfMessageInfo::byte_bus_id and AcfMessageInfo::transaction_num it echoes, so that two outstanding requests with distinct (byte_bus_id, transaction_num) pairs each receive their own response.

requirements.title: Server and Client close() are idempotent and requests after close fail
requirements.text: rcp::udp::Server::close and rcp::udp::Client::close shall be safe to call more than once without blocking indefinitely or crashing, and rcp::udp::Client::request shall return rcp::ErrClosed once the Client has been closed.

requirements.title: TC18 end-to-end CRC32 algorithm parameters
requirements.text: rcp::e2e::crc32 shall compute a 32-bit CRC using polynomial 0xF4ACFB13, initial value 0xFFFFFFFF, both input and output reflection enabled, and a final XOR of 0xFFFFFFFF.

requirements.title: CRC coverage buffer layout
requirements.text: rcp::e2e::coverage_buffer shall assemble, in order, the 8-byte big-endian stream_id, the 4-byte big-endian avtp_timestamp (zero-filled when std::nullopt is passed, the NTSCF stand-in), the 10-byte ACF shared header, and the payload; rcp::e2e::compute_crc shall compute the CRC over exactly that buffer.

requirements.title: Trailing-CRC length pre-adjustment
requirements.text: rcp::e2e::apply_acf_length_adjustment shall add exactly kCrcLengthAdjustQuadlets (1) to AcfMessageInfo::acf_msg_length; rcp::e2e::apply_frame_length_adjustment shall add exactly kCrcLengthAdjustOctets (4) to an NtscfHeader's or TscfHeader's control_data_length.

requirements.title: verify_crc detects a mismatched or corrupted CRC
requirements.text: rcp::e2e::verify_crc shall return {} when the received CRC matches compute_crc's result and shall return E2eErrc::crc_error (CRC_ERROR) otherwise.

requirements.title: Per-endpoint CRC safe-mode toggles gate per message role
requirements.text: rcp::e2e::crc_required shall report regmap::EndpointGenericConfig::ep_req_crc_enable, ep_ack_crc_enable, and ep_response_crc_enable independently for MessageRole::Request, Acknowledge, and Response respectively; rcp::e2e::implemented_options_bit shall report regmap::kOptSafetyRequests only when its safety_requests_implemented argument is true.

requirements.title: RxStreamGuard implements rx_enforce_e2e's drop-vs-latch rule
requirements.text: rcp::e2e::RxStreamGuard::record_crc_result shall return CRC_ERROR for a failing request without affecting later requests when RequestStreamConfig::rx_enforce_e2e is clear, and shall additionally latch the whole stream (every subsequent call reports CRC_ERROR until reset_latch()) when rx_enforce_e2e is set.

requirements.title: RxSequenceGuard enforces rx_enforce_seq independently of the watchdog
requirements.text: rcp::e2e::RxSequenceGuard::check shall accept every sequence number when RequestStreamConfig::rx_enforce_seq is clear, and shall return E2eErrc::sequence_violation for any sequence number that is not strictly greater than the last accepted one when rx_enforce_seq is set.

requirements.title: RxWatchdog overflow detection respects rx_wd_enable and rx_wd_timeout_interval
requirements.text: rcp::e2e::RxWatchdog::overflowed shall return false when RequestStreamConfig::rx_wd_enable is clear or kick() has never been called, and shall return true once more than rx_wd_timeout_interval milliseconds have elapsed since the last kick().

requirements.title: Watchdog overflow purges normal requests and retains safety-tagged ones
requirements.text: rcp::e2e::apply_watchdog_overflow shall, when RequestStreamConfig::rx_wd_safestate_enable is set, latch the RxWatchdog into safe state and cancel every pending/started request on the ledger whose sequencer::RequestRecord::is_safety is false while leaving is_safety=true records untouched (via RequestLedger::cancel_all(true)); it shall purge nothing and not enter safe state when rx_wd_safestate_enable is clear.

requirements.title: Queue overflow drives the same purge-normal/retain-safety rule via a distinct trigger
requirements.text: rcp::e2e::apply_queue_overflow shall implement the same purge-normal/retain-safety behavior as apply_watchdog_overflow, gated on RequestStreamConfig::rx_ovrflw_safestate_enable instead of rx_wd_safestate_enable.

requirements.title: endpoint_in_configured_safe_state implements both rx_safety_measure strategies
requirements.text: rcp::e2e::endpoint_in_configured_safe_state shall return the caller-supplied force_high_impedance_asserted flag unchanged when RequestStreamConfig::rx_safety_measure is RxSafetyMeasure::ForceHighImpedance, and shall return whether rx_safestate_sequencer's current SequencerTable value equals rx_safe_sequencer_state (false if the index is out of range) when rx_safety_measure is RxSafetyMeasure::RunSafeSequencer.

requirements.title: may_execute_now gates safety-tagged requests on safe-state entry
requirements.text: rcp::e2e::may_execute_now shall return true unconditionally for a sequencer::RequestRecord whose is_safety is false, and shall return its endpoint_in_safe_state argument unchanged for a record whose is_safety is true.

requirements.title: RxWatchdog repeating info notification tracks rx_wd_info_enable while latched
requirements.text: rcp::e2e::RxWatchdog::should_emit_info_notification shall return true if and only if the watchdog is currently latched into safe state (enter_safe_state() called, clear_safe_state() not since called) and RequestStreamConfig::rx_wd_info_enable is set.

requirements.title: E2eErrc is a distinct error category with non-empty, distinct messages
requirements.text: Every rcp::e2e::E2eErrc value shall report rcp::e2e::e2e_category() as its category and shall have a non-empty diagnostic message distinct from every other E2eErrc value's message.

requirements.title: StreamWatchdog reports overflow per rx_wd_enable/rx_wd_timeout_interval
requirements.text: rcp::watchdog::StreamWatchdog::check shall report HealthEvent::overflowed only once more than RequestStreamConfig::rx_wd_timeout_interval milliseconds have elapsed since the stream's last kick_from_request call, and only while RequestStreamConfig::rx_wd_enable is set.

requirements.title: kick_from_request resets the watchdog for any inbound request
requirements.text: rcp::watchdog::StreamWatchdog::kick_from_request shall reset that stream's watchdog on every call, regardless of the accepted request's kind or is_safety tag.

requirements.title: Overflow purges normal requests and retains safety-tagged ones when safestate-enabled
requirements.text: rcp::watchdog::StreamWatchdog::check shall, on overflow while RequestStreamConfig::rx_wd_safestate_enable is set, latch the stream into safe state and cancel every pending/started non-safety request on the supplied RequestLedger while leaving is_safety=true records untouched, reporting HealthEvent::entered_safe_state and the purge count; it shall latch nothing and purge nothing when rx_wd_safestate_enable is clear.

requirements.title: Latched safe state does not re-fire until explicitly cleared
requirements.text: Once rcp::watchdog::StreamWatchdog::check has latched a stream into safe state, subsequent check calls shall not re-detect overflow for that stream until clear_safe_state is called.

requirements.title: Repeating info notification while latched
requirements.text: rcp::watchdog::StreamWatchdog::check shall report HealthEvent::info_notification_due on every call while the stream is latched into safe state and RequestStreamConfig::rx_wd_info_enable is set, and shall not report it otherwise.

requirements.title: Manager multiplexes independent per-stream watchdog state
requirements.text: rcp::watchdog::Manager shall track each registered stream_key's watchdog state independently, such that kicking, overflowing, or latching one registered stream shall not affect any other registered stream's state.

requirements.title: Unregistered stream operations report stream_not_registered
requirements.text: rcp::watchdog::Manager::on_request_received, poll, and clear_safe_state shall return WatchdogErrc::stream_not_registered, unchanged, for any stream_key not passed to register_stream, without altering any other registered stream's state.

requirements.title: Subscribed callbacks fire in registration order
requirements.text: rcp::watchdog::Manager::poll shall invoke every callback registered via subscribe, in registration order, exactly once for each HealthEvent it produces.

requirements.title: Never-reported target is dead
requirements.text: rcp::deadline::LivenessTracker::dead shall return true for a target on which note_activity has never been called, regardless of the elapsed time argument.

requirements.title: Heartbeat and lifecycle-change signals are independently sufficient
requirements.text: rcp::deadline::Monitor::note_heartbeat and note_lifecycle_change shall each independently reset a registered target's last-seen-activity clock, such that either call alone is sufficient to keep that target's LivenessTracker::dead false within the configured deadline.

requirements.title: Dead event fires on the first check of a never-reported target
requirements.text: rcp::deadline::Monitor::check shall emit LivenessEvent{alive=false} for a registered target that has never received a note_heartbeat/note_lifecycle_change call, on the first check call that evaluates it.

requirements.title: Repeated dead events suppressed
requirements.text: rcp::deadline::Monitor::check shall not re-emit LivenessEvent{alive=false} for a target whose alive state was already reported false by a prior check call.

requirements.title: Alive event fires on recovery
requirements.text: rcp::deadline::Monitor::check shall emit LivenessEvent{alive=true} for a target whose prior reported state was dead once a note_heartbeat/note_lifecycle_change call has occurred within the configured deadline before that check call.

requirements.title: alive() returns false before any check
requirements.text: rcp::deadline::Monitor::alive shall return false for any target not yet evaluated by check, including a target that has already received a note_heartbeat/note_lifecycle_change call.

requirements.title: Subscribed callbacks fire in registration order
requirements.text: rcp::deadline::Monitor::check shall invoke every callback registered via subscribe, in registration order, exactly once for each LivenessEvent it produces.

requirements.title: Targets are evaluated independently
requirements.text: rcp::deadline::Monitor::check shall evaluate each registered target's liveness independently, such that one target's deadline expiry or recovery shall not affect any other registered target's reported alive state.

requirements.title: PowerManager starts in Normal with four defined modes
requirements.text: rcp::powerstate::PowerMode shall define exactly four modes (Normal, StandBy, Sleep, Unpowered), and a freshly constructed PowerManager shall report Normal as its initial mode() value.

requirements.title: enter_standby/enter_sleep are only defined from Normal
requirements.text: PowerManager::enter_standby and PowerManager::enter_sleep shall succeed only when mode() is Normal, transitioning to the requested low-power mode, and shall return PowerErrc::invalid_transition without changing mode() when called from any other mode.

requirements.title: Entry refusal: unacknowledged wake-up event
requirements.text: PowerManager::enter_standby/enter_sleep shall return PowerErrc::unacknowledged_wakeup_event without changing mode() whenever the associated WakeupEndpoint::wakeup_message_pending() reports true.

requirements.title: Entry refusal: non-idle endpoint
requirements.text: PowerManager::enter_standby/enter_sleep shall return PowerErrc::endpoint_not_idle without changing mode() whenever the configured Hooks::endpoints_idle predicate returns false.

requirements.title: Entry refusal: non-empty response/ack queue
requirements.text: PowerManager::enter_standby/enter_sleep shall return PowerErrc::response_ack_queue_not_empty without changing mode() whenever the configured Hooks::response_ack_queues_empty predicate returns false.

requirements.title: StandBy always resumes as a hot start with no handshake
requirements.text: PowerManager::resume_from_standby shall, when mode() is StandBy, transition directly to Normal without invoking any hot-start-from-Sleep handshake hook, and shall return PowerErrc::invalid_transition without changing mode() when called from any other mode.

requirements.title: begin_wake_from_sleep requires Sleep and re-enables the network interface
requirements.text: PowerManager::begin_wake_from_sleep shall, when mode() is Sleep, invoke the configured Hooks::reenable_network_interface hook exactly once and set wake_stage() to HandshakeActive while leaving mode() at Sleep, and shall return PowerErrc::not_asleep without side effects when mode() is not Sleep.

requirements.title: Handshake steps are refused outside of an active handshake
requirements.text: PowerManager::note_wakeup_attempt_sent and PowerManager::acknowledge_wakeup shall both return PowerErrc::not_asleep without side effects whenever wake_stage() is not HandshakeActive.

requirements.title: note_wakeup_attempt_sent enforces the WakeUp repeat limit
requirements.text: PowerManager::note_wakeup_attempt_sent shall return PowerErrc::handshake_repeat_limit_exceeded and set wake_stage() to Failed once it has been called more than Config::wakeup_repeat_limit times since begin_wake_from_sleep while the associated WakeupEndpoint::wakeup_message_pending() continues to report true, and mode() shall remain Sleep when this occurs.

requirements.title: acknowledge_wakeup completes the handshake and returns to Normal
requirements.text: PowerManager::acknowledge_wakeup shall, while wake_stage() is HandshakeActive, call the associated WakeupEndpoint::acknowledge_wakeup, invoke the configured Hooks::reenable_response_ack_queues hook exactly once, set wake_stage() to Complete, and transition mode() to Normal.

requirements.title: notify_power_removed forces Unpowered unconditionally
requirements.text: PowerManager::notify_power_removed shall set mode() to Unpowered regardless of the current mode() or any entry-refusal condition that would otherwise apply to enter_standby/enter_sleep.

requirements.title: notify_power_restored returns to Normal from Unpowered
requirements.text: PowerManager::notify_power_restored shall set mode() to Normal and wake_stage() to Idle.

requirements.title: start_kind_on_exit fixes StandBy as hot and Sleep as cold
requirements.text: rcp::powerstate::start_kind_on_exit shall return StartKind::Hot for PowerMode::StandBy and StartKind::Cold for PowerMode::Sleep, and PowerManager::pending_start_kind shall report start_kind_on_exit(mode()).

requirements.title: PowerErrc is a distinct error category with a non-empty message
requirements.text: rcp::powerstate::make_error_code(PowerErrc::invalid_transition) shall report rcp::powerstate::power_category() as its category and shall have a non-empty diagnostic message.

requirements.title: Higher priority dispatched first
requirements.text: prioqueue::Controller shall dispatch Priority::Critical before Priority::High before Priority::Normal when multiple commands are queued.

requirements.title: FIFO within same priority
requirements.text: Commands with equal priority shall be dispatched in the order they were submitted (first-in, first-out).

requirements.title: Deadline respected per entry
requirements.text: If a queued command's context deadline expires before dispatch, send() shall return ErrTimeout.

requirements.title: done() context rejected
requirements.text: send() shall return ErrTimeout immediately if the provided context is already done.

requirements.title: Zone mismatch rejected
requirements.text: send() shall return ErrZoneMismatch if cmd.zone differs from the inner controller's zone.

requirements.title: Subscribe delegates to inner
requirements.text: subscribe() shall delegate directly to the inner controller.

requirements.title: Close stops dispatch thread
requirements.text: close() shall stop the dispatch thread and cause subsequent send() calls to return ErrClosed.

requirements.title: send() after close returns ErrClosed
requirements.text: Any send() call after close() shall return ErrClosed.

requirements.title: Manager::admit admits while the domain's bucket has tokens
requirements.text: rcp::ratelimit::Manager::admit shall return a success (falsy) std::error_code for a target EndpointKey whose token bucket has at least one token available.

requirements.title: Tokens refill proportionally to elapsed now_ms
requirements.text: rcp::ratelimit::TokenBucket::take shall refill tokens proportionally to the elapsed now_ms since the previous take() call on the same bucket, before evaluating admission, capped at Config::burst.

requirements.title: admit() returns ErrAdmissionDenied once the bucket is exhausted
requirements.text: rcp::ratelimit::Manager::admit shall return ratelimit::ErrAdmissionDenied, unchanged, once fewer than one token remains in the target EndpointKey's bucket.

requirements.title: Safety-tagged requests bypass the bucket when exempted
requirements.text: When Config::exempt_safety_tagged is true, rcp::ratelimit::Manager::admit shall return success for an is_safety_tagged=true request without consuming a token, regardless of the target bucket's remaining token count.

requirements.title: Safety-tagged requests are throttled when not exempted
requirements.text: When Config::exempt_safety_tagged is false, rcp::ratelimit::Manager::admit shall subject an is_safety_tagged=true request to the same token-bucket admission check as any other request.

requirements.title: Distinct (stream, endpoint) domains have independent buckets
requirements.text: rcp::ratelimit::Manager shall maintain an independent token bucket per distinct EndpointKey, such that exhausting one EndpointKey's bucket shall not affect admission for any other EndpointKey.

requirements.title: reset() rebuilds a domain's bucket at full burst
requirements.text: rcp::ratelimit::Manager::reset shall discard the target EndpointKey's bucket state, such that its next admit() call is evaluated against a freshly constructed bucket at full Config::burst capacity.

requirements.title: ErrAdmissionDenied is a distinct error code
requirements.text: ratelimit::ErrAdmissionDenied shall be a non-zero std::error_code in a category distinct from every other rcp error category.

requirements.title: dispatch forwards to the wrapped mock::Server by default
requirements.text: sim::Simulator::dispatch shall, absent an injected fault, forward its request unchanged to the wrapped mock::Server::dispatch and return its result.

requirements.title: fault() causes dispatch to fail without touching the server
requirements.text: sim::Simulator::fault(ec) shall cause every subsequent dispatch() call to return ec and an ErrorResponse without calling mock::Server::dispatch, until recover() is called.

requirements.title: recover() restores normal dispatch
requirements.text: sim::Simulator::recover() shall clear any injected fault and restore dispatch() to forwarding requests to the wrapped mock::Server.

requirements.title: Constant latency model always reports base_latency
requirements.text: sim::Simulator::simulated_latency_ms, when Config::latency_model is LatencyModel::Constant, shall always return Config::base_latency.

requirements.title: Jitter latency model reports a delay within [base_latency, base_latency+jitter]
requirements.text: sim::Simulator::simulated_latency_ms, when Config::latency_model is LatencyModel::Jitter, shall return a value uniformly distributed in [base_latency, base_latency + jitter].

requirements.title: dispatch kicks a registered stream's watchdog on every accepted request
requirements.text: sim::Simulator::dispatch shall call watchdog::Manager::on_request_received for stream_key when that stream is registered (via register_stream), resetting its watchdog per rcp/watchdog.hpp's reset-by-any-inbound-request rule.

requirements.title: dispatch on an unregistered stream does not touch the watchdog manager
requirements.text: sim::Simulator::dispatch, for a stream_key never passed to register_stream, shall not call watchdog::Manager::on_request_received and shall leave that stream unregistered.

requirements.title: No fault when no rules
requirements.text: When no rules are active, send() shall delegate to the inner controller unchanged.

requirements.title: Drop rule returns error without calling inner
requirements.text: A Drop rule shall cause send() to return an error without calling the inner controller.

requirements.title: Error rule returns ResponseStatus::Error
requirements.text: An Error rule shall return {} (no error code) with the Response status set to ResponseStatus::Error.

requirements.title: Slow rule adds configured latency
requirements.text: A Slow rule shall sleep for Rule::latency before delegating to the inner controller.

requirements.title: Count-based rule expires after N firings
requirements.text: A rule with count > 0 shall auto-expire after count applications and be removed from the active list.

requirements.title: clear_rules() removes all active rules
requirements.text: clear_rules() shall remove all rules, returning the controller to pass-through mode.

requirements.title: Timeout rule returns ErrTimeout
requirements.text: A Timeout rule shall return ErrTimeout without calling the inner controller.

requirements.title: zone() delegates to inner
requirements.text: zone() shall return the inner controller's zone.

requirements.title: loan() returns zeroed buffer
requirements.text: loan::BufferPool::loan(n) shall return a zeroed byte vector of exactly n bytes.

requirements.title: loan() returns ErrClosed when closed
requirements.text: loan() shall return ErrClosed once the pool has been closed.

requirements.title: loan() returns an error for negative size
requirements.text: loan() shall return std::errc::invalid_argument if size < 0.

requirements.title: Released buffers become available for reuse
requirements.text: A Loan's buffer, once released (destruction or explicit ret()), shall become available for a subsequent loan() call to draw from the pool rather than freshly allocating.

requirements.title: Released buffers are re-zeroed before reuse
requirements.text: A buffer drawn from the pool via loan() shall be re-zeroed, even if a prior borrower left non-zero data in it, so no stale data leaks across reuse.

requirements.title: close() is idempotent and safe with outstanding Loans alive
requirements.text: BufferPool::close() shall be safe to call more than once, including while Loans obtained before the call are still alive.

requirements.title: Mutual TLS authentication for the UDP/IP transport
requirements.text: The secure channel option for rcp/udp.hpp's transport shall require both client and server to present valid X.509 certificates once a real (D)TLS backend is enabled.

requirements.title: Certificate verification by CA
requirements.text: Certificates shall be verified against the configured CA bundle; self-signed certs shall be rejected unless the CA is the cert itself.

requirements.title: Config::verify_peer=true by default
requirements.text: Certificate verification shall be enabled by default.

requirements.title: PEM file support
requirements.text: cert_file, key_file, and ca_file shall accept paths to PEM-formatted files.

requirements.title: SecureClient never sends a request in the clear without a real backend
requirements.text: Without RCP_TLS_OPENSSL, SecureClient::request shall return function_not_supported for every call rather than transmitting an unencrypted AVTPDU-framed request.

requirements.title: SecureServer never reports itself usable without a real backend
requirements.text: Without RCP_TLS_OPENSSL, SecureServer::ok() shall report false, so an embedding cannot mistake the stub for a securely bound server.

requirements.title: TLS 1.2+ enforced
requirements.text: Connections with TLS protocol version below 1.2 shall be rejected.

requirements.title: Weak cipher suites disabled
requirements.text: NULL, RC4, EXPORT, and DES cipher suites shall be disabled.

requirements.title: close() terminates the secure session cleanly
requirements.text: SecureClient::close and SecureServer::close shall perform a clean shutdown and be safe to call more than once.

requirements.title: stream_id and Config are carried unchanged
requirements.text: SecureClient and SecureServer shall expose the stream_id and Config they were constructed with, unchanged, for the embedding application to introspect.

requirements.title: In-process zero-copy delivery
requirements.text: shmem::Channel::request() shall deliver a request to the registered Handler directly, without serialising to a byte buffer.

requirements.title: Custom handler invoked, else default Acknowledge
requirements.text: If set_handler() has been called, the handler shall be invoked for each request() call; otherwise Channel::request() shall answer ResponseKind::Acknowledge.

requirements.title: ErrClosed after close()
requirements.text: Channel::request() shall return ErrClosed once the Channel has been closed.

requirements.title: Registry::lookup finds a channel registered via add_channel
requirements.text: shmem::Registry::lookup() shall return the Channel for a stream_key registered via add_channel().

requirements.title: Registry::close() closes all registered channels
requirements.text: Registry::close() shall close every registered Channel and cause subsequent lookup() calls to return ErrClosed.

requirements.title: Channel::request is thread-safe for concurrent callers
requirements.text: Concurrent calls to Channel::request() from different threads shall not result in data races or lost/duplicated handler invocations.

requirements.title: Client id is forwarded to the handler unchanged
requirements.text: The caller-supplied client id passed to Channel::request() shall be forwarded to the registered Handler unchanged.

requirements.title: close() is idempotent
requirements.text: Channel::close() and Registry::close() shall be safe to call more than once without crashing or blocking.

requirements.title: apply_priority sets SO_PRIORITY per RequestCategory
requirements.text: tsn::apply_priority(fd, cfg, category) shall set the SO_PRIORITY socket option proportional to the request's rcp::request::RequestCategory before the next send on that socket, on platforms where RCP_TSN_SO_PRIORITY is defined; on other platforms it shall succeed as a no-op.

requirements.title: PCPMap maps every RequestCategory to a PCP value
requirements.text: The PCPMap struct shall provide a separate PCP value for each of the seven rcp::request::RequestCategory values.

requirements.title: Cancellation mapped to the highest PCP
requirements.text: RequestCategory::Cancellation (execution-priority rank 0) shall be mapped to PCP 7 by default.

requirements.title: Triggered mapped to a mid/high-range PCP
requirements.text: RequestCategory::Triggered shall be mapped to PCP 6 by default.

requirements.title: Standard mapped to the lowest PCP
requirements.text: RequestCategory::Standard (the mandatory baseline kind, execution-priority rank 6) shall be mapped to PCP 1 by default, and the default PCPMap shall preserve the full seven-category execution-priority ordering.

requirements.title: apply_priority rejects an invalid socket fd
requirements.text: apply_priority shall return std::errc::invalid_argument for a negative fd, on every platform.

requirements.title: Discoverer interface for udp::Server host:port discovery
requirements.text: mdns::Discoverer shall define the abstract interface for mDNS-based discovery of udp::Server instances reachable at a host:port, for the UDP/IP transport variant only.

requirements.title: start() fires Added event for each discovered server
requirements.text: Discoverer::start() shall invoke the callback with EventType::Added for each discovered ServerInfo.

requirements.title: stop() terminates discovery
requirements.text: Discoverer::stop() shall cause the discoverer to stop emitting events.

requirements.title: StaticDiscoverer emits configured servers
requirements.text: StaticDiscoverer::start() shall emit all configured ServerInfo entries synchronously before returning.

requirements.title: ServerInfo carries stream_key, host, and port
requirements.text: ServerInfo shall carry the opaque stream_key (typically avtp::StreamId::to_u64()), host string, port number, and service instance name.

requirements.title: instance_name follows _rcp._udp.local convention
requirements.text: make_instance_name() shall produce names of the form '<hex-stream-key>.<host>._rcp._udp.local', distinct for every distinct stream_id.

requirements.title: Announcer interface for udp::Server registration
requirements.text: mdns::Announcer shall define the abstract interface for announcing a udp::Server via the local mDNS responder.

requirements.title: withdraw() removes mDNS record
requirements.text: Announcer::withdraw(stream_key) shall remove the mDNS record for the given stream_key.

requirements.title: AccessPolicy::permit grants access only on a full (identity, stream, endpoint, kind) match
requirements.text: rcp::authz::AccessPolicy::permit shall return true only when at least one PolicyEntry for the given identity matches the given target stream, target endpoint, and request kind simultaneously; it shall return false if any one axis does not match.

requirements.title: Empty streams/endpoints/kinds sets mean unrestricted on that axis
requirements.text: A PolicyEntry with an empty streams set shall match any target stream. A PolicyEntry with an empty endpoints set shall match any target endpoint. A PolicyEntry with an empty kinds set shall match any request kind.

requirements.title: Identity not covered by any PolicyEntry is denied
requirements.text: rcp::authz::AccessPolicy::permit shall return false for any identity with no PolicyEntry present in the policy, regardless of the requested stream, endpoint, or kind.

requirements.title: AccessPolicy is thread-safe
requirements.text: Concurrent calls to AccessPolicy::allow() and AccessPolicy::permit() from different threads shall not result in data races.

requirements.title: check() returns ErrForbidden when permit() would deny
requirements.text: rcp::authz::check shall return authz::ErrForbidden, unchanged, whenever the equivalent AccessPolicy::permit() call would return false.

requirements.title: check() returns success when permit() would allow
requirements.text: rcp::authz::check shall return a default-constructed (falsy) std::error_code whenever the equivalent AccessPolicy::permit() call would return true.

requirements.title: An identity with zero policy entries is denied by default
requirements.text: rcp::authz::AccessPolicy::permit shall return false for any identity for which AccessPolicy::allow() has never been called, i.e. the policy defaults to deny, not allow.

requirements.title: ErrForbidden is a distinct error code
requirements.text: authz::ErrForbidden shall be a non-zero std::error_code in a category distinct from every other rcp error category.

requirements.title: FirmwareSession begins in Idle state
requirements.text: A freshly constructed FirmwareSession shall report SessionState::Idle.

requirements.title: initiate transitions to Initiated
requirements.text: FirmwareSession::initiate() shall transition the session to SessionState::Initiated on success.

requirements.title: transfer requires Initiated state
requirements.text: FirmwareSession::transfer() shall return FirmwareErrc::bad_state if the session is not in Initiated state.

requirements.title: verify requires Transferring state
requirements.text: FirmwareSession::verify() shall return FirmwareErrc::bad_state if the session is not in Transferring state.

requirements.title: activate requires Verifying state
requirements.text: FirmwareSession::activate() shall return FirmwareErrc::bad_state if the session is not in Verifying state.

requirements.title: transfer chunks firmware in Config::chunk_size segments
requirements.text: FirmwareSession::transfer() shall send the image in segments not exceeding Config::chunk_size bytes.

requirements.title: rollback resets session to Idle
requirements.text: FirmwareSession::rollback() shall reset the session state to Idle on success.

requirements.title: transfer progress callback is called per chunk
requirements.text: If a ProgressCallback is supplied, FirmwareSession::transfer() shall invoke it once for each chunk successfully delivered.

requirements.title: ZoneGroup::all() contains all five zones
requirements.text: ZoneGroup::all() shall return a group containing Zone::FrontLeft, FrontRight, RearLeft, RearRight, and Central.

requirements.title: send_group dispatches to every zone concurrently
requirements.text: GroupRegistry::send_group() shall dispatch the command to all zones in the group using independent asynchronous tasks.

requirements.title: GroupResponse::ok() is false if any zone fails
requirements.text: GroupResponse::ok() shall return false if any per-zone result has a non-zero error_code.

requirements.title: GroupResponse::errors() lists failing zones
requirements.text: GroupResponse::errors() shall return the set of zones for which the error_code is non-zero.

requirements.title: ZoneGroup is a value type
requirements.text: ZoneGroup shall be copyable and default-constructible.

requirements.title: send_group uses caller context deadline
requirements.text: GroupRegistry::send_group() shall forward the caller's Context (including deadline) to each zone controller.

requirements.title: ProxyController enforces latency budget
requirements.text: ProxyController::send() shall derive a tighter deadline equal to min(caller deadline, now + latency_budget) and forward that to the upstream controller.

requirements.title: ProxyRegistry::lookup returns proxy-wrapped controller
requirements.text: Controllers added via ProxyRegistry::add_route() shall be wrapped in a ProxyController before being returned by lookup().

requirements.title: ProxyRegistry::deregister closes upstream
requirements.text: ProxyRegistry::deregister() shall call close() on the removed controller.

requirements.title: ProxyRegistry returns ErrNotFound for unknown zones
requirements.text: ProxyRegistry::lookup() shall return ErrNotFound for zones not registered via add_route().

requirements.title: ProxyRegistry close is idempotent
requirements.text: Calling ProxyRegistry::close() more than once shall return no error on subsequent calls.

requirements.title: ProxyController zone() matches upstream
requirements.text: ProxyController::zone() shall return the same zone as the wrapped upstream controller.

requirements.title: RedundantController routes sends to primary
requirements.text: RedundantController::send() shall forward commands to the primary controller when it is active.

requirements.title: RedundantController promotes standby on ErrClosed
requirements.text: When the primary returns ErrClosed and auto_promote is true, RedundantController shall promote the standby and retry.

requirements.title: RedundantController promotes standby on ErrTimeout
requirements.text: When the primary returns ErrTimeout and auto_promote is true, RedundantController shall promote the standby and retry.

requirements.title: promote() is manually invocable
requirements.text: RedundantController::promote() shall switch the active controller between primary and standby.

requirements.title: is_primary_active reflects current active
requirements.text: RedundantController::is_primary_active() shall return true when primary is active and false when standby is active.

requirements.title: close() closes both controllers
requirements.text: RedundantController::close() shall call close() on both the primary and standby controllers.

requirements.title: auto_promote=false disables automatic failover
requirements.text: When Config::auto_promote is false, RedundantController::send() shall not switch to standby on primary failure.

requirements.title: zone() returns zone of active controller
requirements.text: RedundantController::zone() shall return the zone of the currently active controller.

requirements.title: FederatedRegistry prefers local over remote lease
requirements.text: When both a local controller and a remote lease exist for the same zone, FederatedRegistry::lookup() shall return the local controller.

requirements.title: Expired lease returns ErrNotFound
requirements.text: FederatedRegistry::lookup() shall return ErrNotFound for a zone whose only entry is an expired Lease.

requirements.title: revoke_lease removes lease immediately
requirements.text: FederatedRegistry::revoke_lease() shall remove the lease so that subsequent lookup() calls return ErrNotFound.

requirements.title: add_lease stores lease for valid zone
requirements.text: FederatedRegistry::add_lease() shall store the lease so that lookup() returns the remote controller until the lease expires.

requirements.title: local_id identifies the HPC node
requirements.text: FederatedRegistry::local_id() shall return the identifier supplied at construction.

requirements.title: close() closes local and remote controllers
requirements.text: FederatedRegistry::close() shall close all local controllers and all remote_ctrl handles in active leases.

requirements.title: closed registry returns ErrClosed on lookup
requirements.text: After FederatedRegistry::close(), lookup() shall return ErrClosed.

requirements.title: register_ctrl returns ErrAlreadyExists for duplicate zone
requirements.text: FederatedRegistry::register_ctrl() shall return ErrAlreadyExists if a controller for that zone is already registered locally.

requirements.title: ObservingClient records a span per request
requirements.text: ObservingClient::request() shall record one Span for every call to the wrapped RequestFn.

requirements.title: Span captures byte_bus_id and acf_msg_type
requirements.text: The Span recorded by ObservingClient shall include the request's byte_bus_id and acf_msg_type.

requirements.title: Span duration is non-negative
requirements.text: The duration() of every recorded Span shall be >= 0 microseconds.

requirements.title: Span captures error code
requirements.text: The Span result field shall reflect the error_code returned by the wrapped RequestFn.

requirements.title: NoopSink does not crash on any metric
requirements.text: NoopSink::record_span(), record_gauge(), and record_counter() shall be no-ops that do not throw.

requirements.title: InMemorySink is thread-safe
requirements.text: Concurrent calls to InMemorySink::record_span() and spans() from different threads shall not result in data races.

requirements.title: ObservingClient increments rcp.requests.total counter
requirements.text: ObservingClient::request() shall call record_counter('rcp.requests.total') once per call.

requirements.title: ObservingClient increments error counter on failure
requirements.text: When request() returns a non-zero error_code, ObservingClient shall also call record_counter('rcp.requests.errors').

requirements.title: AdminServer::zones() returns all registered controllers
requirements.text: AdminServer::zones() shall return one ZoneInfo entry for every controller registered in the wrapped Registry.

requirements.title: AdminServer broadcasts events to all subscribers
requirements.text: AdminServer::emit() shall invoke every registered EventCallback with the supplied Event.

requirements.title: AdminServer::metrics_text outputs Prometheus format
requirements.text: AdminServer::metrics_text() shall return a string containing TYPE and metric lines in Prometheus text exposition format.

requirements.title: record_counter accumulates delta values
requirements.text: Multiple calls to AdminServer::record_counter() for the same name+labels shall accumulate the delta values.

requirements.title: AdminServer is thread-safe
requirements.text: Concurrent calls to AdminServer::subscribe(), emit(), and metrics_text() shall not result in data races.

requirements.title: ZoneInfo.registered is true for all listed zones
requirements.text: All ZoneInfo entries returned by AdminServer::zones() shall have registered = true.

requirements.title: Multiple subscribers all receive each event
requirements.text: If N subscribers are registered, AdminServer::emit() shall invoke all N callbacks for each event.

requirements.title: EventCallback receives event with correct type and zone
requirements.text: The Event passed to each EventCallback shall have the EventType and Zone specified in the emit() call.

requirements.title: RecordingClient captures request and response
requirements.text: RecordingClient::request() shall append one Entry to the Record containing the request AcfMessageInfo/payload, the response AcfMessageInfo/payload, and the resulting error_code, for every call.

requirements.title: Record::size() reflects number of completed request() calls
requirements.text: Record::size() shall equal the total number of completed request() calls through the RecordingClient.

requirements.title: Record::write_binary/read_binary round-trip entries losslessly
requirements.text: Record::write_binary() shall serialise every captured Entry to a file, and Record::read_binary() shall recover the timestamp, request/response AcfMessageInfo fields, and request/response payloads unchanged.

requirements.title: Playback::run_all replays all entries
requirements.text: Playback::run_all() shall replay one request for every entry in the Record against the target RequestFn.

requirements.title: Playback with speed_factor=0 skips inter-entry delays
requirements.text: When PlaybackConfig::speed_factor is 0.0, Playback::run_all() shall not sleep between entries.

requirements.title: Entry timestamp_ns is monotonically increasing
requirements.text: The timestamp_ns fields of consecutive entries appended to a Record shall be non-decreasing.

requirements.title: RecordingClient forwards the inner error_code unchanged
requirements.text: RecordingClient::request() shall return the same error_code as the wrapped RequestFn.

requirements.title: Record is thread-safe for concurrent appends
requirements.text: Concurrent calls to Record::append() from different threads shall not result in data races.

requirements.title: parse_json extracts zone entries
requirements.text: config::parse_json() shall return a Manifest containing one ZoneManifestEntry for each object with a 'zone' key in the input JSON.

requirements.title: parse_json throws ParseError for unknown zones
requirements.text: config::parse_json() shall throw config::ParseError if the 'zone' string value does not match a known Zone name.

requirements.title: parse_json extracts priority field
requirements.text: config::parse_json() shall populate ZoneManifestEntry::priority from the 'priority' JSON field when present.

requirements.title: config::load registers controllers in registry
requirements.text: config::load() shall call registry.register_ctrl() for each zone defined in the manifest.

requirements.title: config::load returns ErrAlreadyExists for duplicate zones
requirements.text: config::load() shall return ErrAlreadyExists if the manifest defines the same zone more than once.

requirements.title: ParseError is a std::runtime_error subclass
requirements.text: config::ParseError shall be derived from std::runtime_error so it can be caught with a standard exception handler.

requirements.title: SchemaRegistry::add rejects duplicate IDs
requirements.text: SchemaRegistry::add() shall return ErrAlreadyExists if a SchemaEntry with the same ID is already registered.

requirements.title: SchemaRegistry::lookup returns false for unknown IDs
requirements.text: SchemaRegistry::lookup() shall return false without modifying the output parameter if the schema ID is not found.

requirements.title: decode of short buffer returns zero schema_id

requirements.title: SchemaRegistry is thread-safe
